title: Maximum cut value
statement: Let $n\ge 0$ and let $G$ be a weighted directed graph on $n$ vertices. Its optimum cut value is the supremum of the cut values attained by all assignments of two labels to its vertices.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a weighted directed graph on the vertex set of size $n$
